The '''Gates of Olaris''' was the gate that separated the [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] city of [[Olaris]], the site of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Taris Resettlement Initiative]], from the [[Rakghoul]]-infested wilderness beyond.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Gates of Olaris appear as an area on Taris in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="SWTOR" />

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1st}}
